pick.name: Infisical Cloud Free
pick.what: Central secrets store syncing to GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel, etc.
pick.why: MIT core = exit path to self-host; syncs one source of truth to many targets across many products
pick.free_limits: 5 identities (human+machine), unlimited projects, 3 envs, 10 secret syncs, no versioning; Pro $23/identity/mo

alts.name: Doppler Developer
alts.free_limits: 3 users (+$8/user), 10 projects, 4 environments, 3-day activity logs; Team $21/user

alts.name: Platform-native secrets + dotenvx
alts.what: wrangler secret put / gh secret set + encrypted .env

decision: One secrets store that syncs to every deploy target beats copy-pasting env vars once there is more than one app or environment. Start with platform-native secrets for a single app, and adopt Infisical (MIT core, self-host exit) when a second app or target appears; Doppler is the polished hosted alternative.

verify.note: Decision presumes 'many products and targets (Workers, GH Actions, VM, local)'.
